opennyai_summary.decision:
The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the FIR dated 12.03.2021 in case no.- 183 of 2021, under Section 498A, 323, 506, 313, IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P.Act, Police Station- Naubasta, District Kanpur Nagar and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.
5. This writ petition is disposed of directing that in case the investigation has not been concluded by the investigating officer till date, the same shall be concluded within period of 60 days.
In case, the petitioners have not been arrested, they shall not be arrested till the conclusion of the investigation proceedings in the aforesaid case.
